definition: to ask god to protect someone
description: In a harbour with colourful wooden fishing boats in front of a honey-coloured church with two bell towers, a young priest in a white robe over a black cassock stands on the stone quay, raises a metal sprinkler and splashes water toward a young woman in a yellow jacket and rubber boots. She stands on a blue and yellow boat with her head bowed and her hands pressed together, then looks up and smiles at him with a hand on her chest as he lowers the sprinkler. Orange nets and ropes lie on the boat.

de.answer: Er segnet die Frau auf dem Boot.
de.question: Was macht der Priester?

es.answer: Está bendiciendo a la mujer del barco.
